Definition: from the base of G4982 and that of G5424; safe (sound) in mind, i.e. self-controlled (moderate as to opinion or passion):--discreet, sober, temperate.
BiblicalUsage: The sober-minded man is the one Paul wants in charge and the one he wants in the home. A bishop must be sober, the aged men must be sober and grave and temperate, and the young women are to be taught to be discreet, chaste, keepers at home.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sober-mindedness is the quiet backbone of the church: clear heads, steady lives, and no show.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
